name: Night Vision
definition: The ability to see under low-light conditions.

benchmark.name: Dark Zurich
benchmark.model_or_system: MGCDA (Map-Guided Curriculum Domain Adaptation, RefineNet ResNet-101 backbone)
benchmark.metric: mIoU (%) over 19 Cityscapes classes on Dark Zurich-test
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who must perceive scene content at night, such as drivers, delivery workers and security staff. The reference is people with normal vision viewing real nighttime urban and suburban driving imagery.

benchmark.name: Dark Zurich
benchmark.metric: mIoU (%) over 19 classes on Dark Zurich-test
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (e.g., typical drivers or pedestrians) perceiving real nighttime urban street scenes

benchmark.name: Dark Zurich
benchmark.model_or_system: Refign-HRDA (Refign applied on top of HRDA, with Cityscapes-pretrained initialization)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population, specifically typical drivers or people who must perceive and interpret urban street scenes at night (Night Vision is a general perceptual ability, not a specialist skill)

benchmark.name: Dark Zurich
benchmark.model_or_system: CISS (Condition-Invariant Semantic Segmentation, built on HRDA)
benchmark.metric: mIoU (%) on Dark Zurich-test, Cityscapes→Dark Zurich unsupervised domain adaptation
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population with normal vision, e.g. drivers and workers who must recognize scene contents in low light. This is a basic perceptual ability, not a specialist skill.

benchmark.name: Dark Zurich
benchmark.metric: mIoU (%) over 19 classes on Dark Zurich-test
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who must see and recognize scene content under low light, such as drivers, security staff and outdoor workers. Reference: the median sighted adult identifying and localizing road, sidewalk, vehicles, people, signs, buildings, vegetation and sky in urban night scenes.

benchmark.name: ExDark
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population. Night vision is a general perceptual ability used in work settings such as driving, security and outdoor work, not a specialist skill.
